cursor.description: Opaque connector cursor; `null` restarts with a full scan.

sequence.description: Sequence number of the last durable envelope of this source and kind.

rejection_generation.description: Incremented when a rejected envelope rewinds the cursor.

restore_sequence.description: Latest manifest-authorized restore reset consumed by this log/cache entry.

last.description:
The newest content or permissions envelope this cursor confirmed. Only
the envelopes that chain back from it, through their `previous`, are
committable: the conditional write of this state is what makes such an
envelope count, so a worker that lost its lease cannot publish.

completed_generation.description: The newest rejection generation that a complete permissions read ended.

description: The durable per-source, per-kind cursor the worker keeps on S3.
title: CursorState

SchemaVersion.description: Contract schema version `<major>.<minor>`. Readers accept any minor of their major and reject other majors.

SyncKind.description: Which of a source's independent syncs produced a batch.

holder.description: Opaque holder identity (host and process), never a user identity.

epoch.description: Incremented on every takeover; fences a former holder.

LastEnvelope.description: A permissions envelope a cursor confirmed.
